This performance underscores Garmin's continued expansion and premium earnings profile, reinforcing its position as a stable large-cap consumer technology company.

feed.title: Four Days Left To Buy Century Communities, Inc. (NYSE:CCS) Before The Ex-Dividend Date
feed.summary: Century Communities, Inc. (NYSE:CCS) is set to trade ex-dividend shortly, with a US$0.32 per share dividend payable on September 9th. While the company's dividend is covered by profits (27% payout ratio), its free cash flow payout of 91% is high, and earnings per share have declined by 5.3% annually over the last five years. This raises concerns about the long-term sustainability and attractiveness of the stock for dividend investors, despite a 16% average annual dividend increase over the same period.

feed.title: Kaos Capital pushes for board changes at Capricor Therapeutics
feed.summary: Kaos Capital Ltd., a shareholder in Capricor Therapeutics Inc. (NASDAQ:CAPR), is demanding immediate board changes, including the nomination of two independent directors and the formation of an M&A and Strategic Alternatives Committee. The investment firm is pushing for a cash preservation plan, citing a significant decrease in Capricor's cash reserves and increased operating expenses. Kaos Capital also highlighted various legal issues faced by Capricor and is prepared to seek shareholder support if their demands are not met.

feed.title: GRS extends Wells Fargo facility by £30m to fund infrastructure push
feed.summary: GRS Group has secured an additional £30 million in financing from Wells Fargo Capital Finance, extending their banking facility for five years until 2031. This funding aims to support GRS's investments in infrastructure, digitalization, circular materials, and supply-chain growth. The deal provides GRS with increased financial stability and flexibility to manage the substantial working capital required for major infrastructure projects, particularly in the UK's growing pipeline of water, rail, highways, and energy projects.

feed.title: Resilient News Corp stock holds above $29 as fresh earnings beat lifts outlook

This performance has led to a more positive outlook for the company, with analysts' average target price suggesting further upside potential. The company's ongoing $1 billion share repurchase program further underscores its commitment to capital return and investor value.

feed.title: Medical records, SSNs, and bank details exposed in CareCloud data breach
feed.summary: Healthcare technology company CareCloud has disclosed a data breach affecting over 3.75 million people, making it one of the largest healthcare data incidents this year. An unauthorized third party accessed one of its AWS environments, exfiltrating sensitive data including full names, SSNs, medical records, and financial details. The article advises affected individuals to take specific steps to protect themselves, such as changing passwords, enabling two-factor authentication, and monitoring for identity theft.

feed.title: An ESPN host is set to make live fantasy picks from 35,000 feet on United
feed.summary: United Airlines and Disney Advertising are partnering to host the 2026 ESPN Fantasy Football Draft with live picks made by ESPN host Tyler Fulghum from a United flight at 35,000 feet, leveraging Starlink inflight Wi-Fi. This event, airing August 25 on ESPN and YouTube, aims to showcase United's Starlink Wi-Fi capabilities, now active on over 500 aircraft, and will include a new commercial featuring Fulghum. The collaboration highlights how improved connectivity allows fans to stay engaged with major events even while traveling.

feed.title: Earnings call transcript: ClearSign beats Q2 2026 EPS forecast as revenue misses
feed.summary: ClearSign Technologies reported a narrower-than-expected loss in Q2 2026, beating EPS forecasts despite revenue falling short of estimates. The company saw a 321% revenue increase year-over-year, driven by flare work, CFD studies, and spare parts orders, and highlighted a strong project pipeline including a Texas petrochemical startup and California burner testing. ClearSign also discussed its new licensing-style burner order, potential for a royalty business, and plans to expand into ethylene furnaces and methane reformers, with management expressing optimism for future revenue growth.

feed.title: The New Upgrade Policy Changes That Delta Air Lines Elite Members Should Know About In 2026
feed.summary: Delta Air Lines is implementing significant changes to its Medallion program for 2026, creating a more strategic environment for elite members. While Medallion Qualifying Dollar (MQD) thresholds remain stable, the availability of complimentary upgrades is decreasing as Delta aims to sell up to 75% of premium cabin inventory. Elite members will see enhancements in Choice Benefits like gifted status and bonus miles, making upgrade certificates increasingly valuable for securing premium seats.

feed.title: Tesla Recalls 3 Million EVs as China Cracks Down on Door Handles

This recall affects over 4 million vehicles in total, with Tesla accounting for the largest portion. The move addresses a problem that has been linked to deadly consequences.

feed.title: AbbVie will present 90% lung cancer response data; the treatment remains investigational
feed.summary: AbbVie announced it will present new data at the 2026 World Conference on Lung Cancer (WCLC) on its investigational lung cancer treatments. Key findings include a 90% objective response rate for ABBV-1480 plus chemotherapy in squamous NSCLC and promising data for telisotuzumab adizutecan (Temab-A) and ABBV-706. Despite positive data, the treatments remain investigational and are not yet approved by health authorities.

feed.title: Intercontinental Exchange Extends $3.9B Revolver, Secures $2B Term Loan as $6.2B Bridge Is Canceled

feed.title: Tesla said fatal Autopilot crash data didn't exist — a $15K bug bounty hacker proved it did, costing Tesla $243 million
feed.summary: A lawsuit against Tesla resulted in a $243 million payout after a hacker proved the company had access to fatal Autopilot crash data, despite claiming otherwise. This incident raises concerns about Tesla's transparency and readiness for its fully autonomous Cybercab rollout, especially as self-driving Teslas continue to be involved in high-profile crashes. The hacker's actions highlighted a critical vulnerability and Tesla's alleged attempts to obscure data related to Autopilot system failures.
